title: When the Weather Burns
author: Felix Halloran
blurb: Beatrix Whitlock, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. But when a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it before the mother's memory goes entirely.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
